prompt: To MOVE a π bond (alkene) from one position to another (e.g., 1-pentene → 2-pentene), the general strategy is:

options.label: Addition of HX or H₂O (Markovnikov) to the π bond, then elimination (E2 with a strong base) in a different direction to form the new π bond on an adjacent position

explanation: To move a π bond, convert it to an sp³ intermediate (halide or alcohol) and then eliminate again. The new elimination can go toward a different β-H, moving the alkene one carbon over. Hofmann vs Zaitsev choice tunes which direction.
